# Rosette Text Analytics

Rosette Text Analytics is a platform that uses natural language processing, statistical modeling, and machine learning to analyze unstructured and semi-structured text across 364 language-encoding-script combinations, revealing valuable information and actionable data.

Category: Data. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/rosette-text-analytics/.

## Actions

- **Address Similarity** (read-only): Compares two addresses and returns a similarity score.
- **Compare Name Similarity** (read-only): The 'name similarity' tool compares two entity names (person, location, or organization) and returns a similarity score between 0 and 1 to…
- **Identify Language** (read-only): This tool identifies the natural language of a given text.
